# Aethyn

> Aethyn proxies are an ethically sourced residential proxy network designed for high-scale data harvesting, web scraping, and automated operations. Learn more at [Aethyn](https://www.aethyn.io).

Aethyn routes requests through real household ISP connections in 195+ countries, achieving a 99.9% success rate and sub-50ms tunnel latency. The platform offers live per-byte billing, unlimited concurrent threads, and native support for HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5 protocols.

## Core Offerings

- **Premium Residential Proxies** (From €2.00/GB at volume; €29.00 for 10 GB/month): Standard pool of 85M+ IPs with 99.5% success rate, country-level targeting, and automatic rotation. Ideal for price monitoring, travel aggregation, SEO tracking, and general web scraping.
- **Elite Residential Proxies** (From €4.50/GB at volume; €65.00 for 10 GB/month): Curated, high-reputation ISP pool of 85M+ IPs with 99.9% success rate. Supports city-level and ISP-level targeting. Designed to bypass advanced anti-bot protections like Cloudflare Enterprise, Akamai, and PerimeterX. Ideal for social media automation, sneaker botting, brand protection, and AI dataset collection.

## Key Capabilities

- **Flexible Rotation & Persistence**: Support for rotation on every request (rotating sessions) or maintaining a single stable IP address for up to 30 minutes (sticky sessions).
- **Multi-Protocol Gateways**: Dual-port architecture allowing seamless switching between HTTP/HTTPS and SOCKS5 without changing credentials.
- **Unified Proxy Endpoint**: Single entrypoint configuration for easier integration into scraping tools, browsers, and custom developer pipelines.
- **Zero Expiring Bandwidth**: PAYG (Pay-As-You-Go) bandwidth has no expiration dates, combined with auto-recharge and per-byte metering.
- **Ethical Compliance**: IPs are sourced strictly from consented peers using opt-in SDKs and KYC-verified partners, aligning with GDPR/CCPA standards.

- [Targeting](https://www.aethyn.io/docs/targeting): Country, city, ISP and ASN targeting syntax, including which options require the Elite pool.
- [Protocols](https://www.aethyn.io/docs/protocols): HTTP, HTTPS and SOCKS5 gateway ports and when to use each.
- [Billing](https://www.aethyn.io/docs/billing): Per-byte metering, wallet top-ups, auto-recharge and why bandwidth does not expire.
- [Browser MCP](https://www.aethyn.io/docs/browser-mcp): Model Context Protocol server that lets an AI agent drive a real browser through Aethyn proxies.

## Key Facts

- Residential proxy network operated by Sai IT Solutions Ltd, Innovation City Free Zone, Ras Al Khaimah, UAE
- Pool: 85M+ residential IPs across 195+ countries
- Two tiers: Premium from €2.00/GB (99.5% success rate) and Elite from €4.50/GB (99.9% success rate)
- Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS and SOCKS5 on a dual-port gateway, one credential set
- Sessions: per-request rotation, or sticky IPs held for up to 30 minutes
- Targeting: country on both tiers; city, ISP and ASN on Elite
- Billing: pay-as-you-go, per-byte metering, no expiring bandwidth, card and cryptocurrency accepted
- Sourcing: consent-based, opt-in SDK peers and KYC-verified partners, GDPR and CCPA aligned
- Industry: web data collection infrastructure / proxy networks
